description: FREE (key, Set up) to set up — a rule (trigger) of a list: when a record is new / changed / meets the conditions, set a status (a new name is created), add a tag, hide it (it leaves the normal flow: no checks, rules, enrichment or sync — restorable), hand it to an EXISTING pipeline (pipelines are made by a person in the app), or ENRICH it — PAID per hit, at most budget_per_record credits per record, on THIS connection's day budget (an empty day makes the rule wait, never overspend). Active at once unless activate: false — set an enrich rule up paused until your user agreed to the budget. include_existing runs it once for the records already in the list. Status, tag and hide need Edit on the list; a pipeline the pipeline's share; enrich Full. Call describe_setup first for the fields and operators.

status.description: A status NAME; a new one is created. "hidden" hides the record

pipeline.description: An EXISTING pipeline's id or name (describe_setup)

fields.description: Fields to fill: email, phone, job_title, linkedin_profile_url, company_name, domain, industry, city, country

conditions.description: Groups are OR-ed, the conditions inside a group AND-ed: { groups: [[cond, cond], [cond]] }

field.description: A field exactly as describe_setup names it, e.g. { "kind": "contentType", "key": "job_title" }, { "kind": "column", "name": "score" }, { "kind": "status" }, { "kind": "tags" }

op.description: An operator describe_setup offers for that field

include_existing.description: Also run once for the records already in the list

language.description: Language of `tell_your_user` and of Yes/No words in new columns (default en)

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list shows the lists shared with you)

on.description: new: new records · changed: changed ones · match: new or changed, once they meet the conditions

name: create_trigger
title: Create a rule
